overview_description.description:
We help financial institutions make better risk decisions with AI.

Synapse Analytics enables them to automate the entire credit lifecycle—from onboarding and verification to assessment and decisioning.

Our AI-powered infrastructure brings speed, accuracy, and intelligence to every step of the credit process. Whether you're serving first-time borrowers or scaling complex lending operations, we help you move faster, reduce risk, and unlock financial access for more customers. With built-in orchestration capabilities, you can centralize fragmented workflows, enforce policies, and coordinate teams—seamlessly and at scale.

Our tools are built for business and risk teams—not technical experts. No-code, intuitive, and ready to use out of the box. Just better decisions, faster.

By simplifying complex processes and reducing barriers, Synapse Analytics plays a key role in expanding financial inclusion—empowering more people and businesses to access the credit they need to grow.

product.name: Konan Credit Decisioning Engine
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates credit decision workflows, enabling real-time loan processing, risk assessment, and portfolio management without coding.

product.name: AI Credit Scoring
product.description: A no-code AutoML solution for building, deploying, and monitoring AI credit scoring models with full decision explainability and risk appetite control.

product.name: Alternative Data Module
product.description: A data enrichment service that integrates diverse alternative data sources to enhance fraud detection and credit risk assessment for lenders and BNPL providers.

product.name: Business Onboarding Platform (Doxter)
product.description: An AI-powered document processing platform that automates business document intake, fraud detection, and compliance checks to accelerate business onboarding.

product.name: Customer Onboarding and eKYC Platform
product.description: A platform that automates customer identity verification, document extraction, fraud detection, and compliance checks to speed up onboarding and reduce errors.

product.name: AI-Powered Cross-Selling Platform
product.description: An AI-driven platform that analyzes customer behavior to deliver personalized product recommendations and optimize cross-selling strategies in real-time.
